name: app-listing-card
title: App listing card
description: An app in a directory or store: icon, name, developer, rating and size, with an action that goes from Get to a progress, then Open or Update.
docs: name is the one link of the card (href, with onOpen for a client-side router). icon is an address; the initials of the name stand in while it loads or if it fails. state is get, installing, installed or update and the action follows it: Get, Installing with its percentage and a progress bar along its foot (progress is 0 to 100; leave it out for a bar of unknown length), Open or Update, each named with the app ('Get Pocketwise'). It is one button throughout, busy and inert while the app installs, so keyboard focus stays on it from Get to Open. Beside the text it shows just the percentage, as wide as Get was, so the text does not move when the install starts; under the text it says 'Installing 42%'. onAction receives the state it was pressed in. A change of state is announced politely once ('Installing Pocketwise', 'Pocketwise installed. You can open it now.'), never every percent. rating and ratingCount draw the stars to the exact average and read as a sentence ('Rated 4.7 from 12,400 ratings'). size is a number of bytes, written '48 MB', or your own words; version '3.2.1' is written 'v3.2.1'. On a card narrower than 24rem the action moves under the text. labels carries every word.
